create.name: Jaime Tan
create.bio:
Jaime Tan teaches meditation and Yoga Nidra from her home in Zürich, and also leads production teams for a large international organisation. Born and raised in Singapore, she has lived in Boston, Cape Town, Sydney and Amsterdam, and has spent more than twenty years studying and teaching meditation and yoga. Her training sits in the Insight Meditation tradition, with long-term study of Insight Yoga, mindfulness and iRest Yoga Nidra with senior teachers such as Jack Kornfield, Tara Brach, Sarah Powers and Richard Miller, and she studied nutrition and wellness before her focus moved to contemplative practice.

Her teaching is aimed at people carrying heavy workloads who want a steadier relationship with effort and rest. On YouTube and Insight Timer she shares short guided meditations, Yoga Nidra and non-sleep deep rest sessions, gentle after-work yoga and reflections on going on silent retreat, and her Insight Timer course builds a week of brief breathing, visualisation and journalling pauses into the working day. She has taught classes in studios and workplaces for many years, now gives talks and workshops on mindful leadership, attention and rest for companies, in person or online, and writes a monthly email of reflections and simple practices.

courses.title: Pause & Thrive: Create Mini Moments Of Resilience
courses.description: A seven-day Insight Timer course for busy workdays. Short breathing exercises for checking in, settling and focusing lead to a guided visualisation and a closing Yoga Nidra, with journalling prompts and ideas for fitting brief pauses into the day.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Talks & Workshops: Practical Mindfulness for Sustainable Performance
courses.description: Talks and workshops of thirty to ninety minutes for teams and leaders, in person or online, on attention, rest as a skill, steady leadership and small daily practices drawn from mindfulness and Yoga Nidra.

free_resources.title: Jaime Tan on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Jaime's guided meditations and Yoga Nidra practices for pausing and resting during a full working life, free to hear in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Yoga Nidra for Deep Rest and Relaxation
free_resources.description: A free Yoga Nidra recording from Jaime, sent by email when you sign up, for lying down and letting the body and mind rest deeply.
